svg.title: The coach writes an eating plan, recorded
svg.desc: A recorded Claude Code session with a made-up athlete: /fitness-coach diet screens first, asks how much to count and what a normal day looks like, then proposes an eating plan built around the athlete's own meals, with its sources.
